body.x: ACE GROUP(CEO Lee, Jong-rin, www.acegng.com) introduced 'iFACE' its design brand of peripheral devices for smartphone at '2014 International CES', the biggest IT∙appliances show held in Las Vegas, U.S. from January 7th to 10th.

For its second consecutive year, ACE GROUP this year took a book to promote 'iFACE' and prepared a meeting space for new buyers. Not only the cases of its main product, the company displayed a variety of smart peripheral devices on booth.

"This year our booth is designed with simpleness and luxuriousness as the iFACE unique features. I believe it will work as impressing global buyers."said CEO Lee, Jong-rin, "With consistent participation at international shows, iFACE will take a leap as a global brand."

iFACE has caught attention from the customers who love impact-resistant, favorable grip feeling and various colors of cases and bags, by its exporting products to USA, Japan, China and other countries.

'CES(The International Consumer Electronics Show)' is owned and produced by the Consumer Electronics Association (CEA), the technology trade association. CES showcases 2,500 ~ 3,200 exhibitors in every kind of electronic appliance. More than 152,000 attendees from more than 150 countries come to the show.
